headline: VERTICES PARTNERS advises TIST Media on seed fundraise
sum: TIST Media Private Limited has raised funds from a seed fundraise, at an estimated valuation of $5.9 million, led by Sthira Partners. VERTICES PARTNERS advised TIST Media on this fundraise.
detail: TIST Media Private Limited has raised funds from a seed fundraise, at an estimated valuation of $5.9 million, led by Sthira Partners. VERTICES PARTNERS advised TIST Media on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Vishal Mehta (Partner), along with a team that consisted of Amit Shekhar Dutta (Senior Associate) and Darshan Rajesh Chheda (Associate). Founder and Managing Partner Vinayak Burman provided strategic inputs.
